# lmw post draft

Build a post outline from an idea (offline)

### Synopsis

Build a post outline from an idea, without contacting LinkedIn.

The outline has a hook, sections to fill in and a closing question.
Replace the [placeholders] before publishing.

```
lmw post draft IDEA... [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help            help for draft
      --length string   length: long, medium, short (default "medium")
  -o, --output string   also save the outline to this file
      --tone string     tone: casual, educational, founder, professional, technical (default "professional")
```
